Name: Another Island Obelisk
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[center][size=4][color=#00ffff]Wish I had a cute little parrot on my farm![/color]
[color=#ffff00]Its appearance and dialogue change with the time, weather, and seasons![/color][/size][/center]

Adds a magical obelisk with an animated parrot that can warp you to various locations on Ginger Island.

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Warp to up to six locations on Ginger Island, unlocked as you progress.[/*]
[*]Seasonal appearances and an animated parrot whose behavior changes with the time and weather.[/*]
[*]Adjustable building costs and unlock requirements.[/*]
[*]Optional One-Tile Mode and texture saturation settings.[/*]
[*]Supports English and Japanese.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Unlock Requirements & Warp Destinations[/b][/size][/color]
[spoiler]
[color=#ffff00][b]Building Requirements[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Reach 7 hearts of friendship with the Wizard.[/*]
[*]Unlock access to the western part of Ginger Island (remove the turtle).[/*]
[/list]Once both requirements are met, you'll receive a letter from the Wizard. Read it to unlock the obelisk in his construction menu.

You can bypass these requirements using the "Ignore Unlock Requirements" option in GMCM.

[color=#ffff00][b]Warp Destinations[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Docks (Beach):[/b] Available from the start.[/*]
[*][b]Farm:[/b] Build the Island Farmhouse.[/*]
[*][b]Walnut Room:[/b] Visit Qi's Walnut Room.[/*]
[*][b]Dig Site:[/b] Repair the Dig Site bridge and unlock the Parrot Express.[/*]
[*][b]Volcano:[/b] Unlock the Volcano exit shortcut and the Parrot Express.[/*]
[*][b]Jungle:[/b] Complete the relevant island event and unlock the Parrot Express.[/*]
[/list]Destinations that haven't been unlocked won't appear in the warp menu.[/spoiler]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Configuration (GMCM)[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Ignore Unlock Requirements:[/b] Build the obelisk as soon as the Wizard's construction menu is available.[/*]
[*][b]Building Cost:[/b] Choose Default, Reduced, or Free.[/*]
[*][b]One-Tile Mode:[/b] Reduce the building's footprint to a single tile.[/*]
[*][b]Texture Saturation:[/b] Choose Vanilla, 30% Reduced, or 50% Reduced.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Requirements & Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4]Requires [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043][/url][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core v1.9.7[/url][/size][/b][size=4][b] or later[/b].[/size]

This version replaces the old Solid Foundations version. Remove the old mod folder before installing the new version.

Existing buildings from the Solid Foundations version are supported through T's Core's building migration system.

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
One-Tile Mode changes the obelisk's size and appearance without affecting its parrot or warp functions.

Do not enable One-Tile Mode when using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11887]Mini Obelisk[/url].
